import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Top 10 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', 10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Gender Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#95a5a6']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_gender[:len(gender_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(gender_counts))
ax2.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution')

# Plot 3: Registrations by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
bars3 = ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Registrations by District')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 20, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# Plot 4: Dog Age Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Filter valid age data
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 25)]
sns.histplot(data=age_data, x='AlterVHundNum', bins=20, ax=ax4, color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='white')
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages')
ax4.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Mean: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].mean():.1f} years')
ax4.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].median(), color='orange', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Median: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].median():.1f} years')
ax4.legend()

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
